_about: The PPO hyperparameter sweep, batches b9-b21. Design and predictions in hyperparam-sweep.md. Expand one batch into desktop specs with: PYTHONPATH=. python -m tools.sweep_specs b9 --out <ops worktree>/snek3/desktop/queue/pending. Write the laptop smoke script for a batch's never-exercised cells with --smoke <file.sh>. Every cell runs at every seed; the control is b7aa-b7ad and is never re-run.

horizon.why: b7's cap: 3,052 rollouts of 16,384. The record-density statistic is still climbing at 30M (8.2% at 20M, 11.3% at 30M, 19.0% at 50M on b7aa) and the b7 fc-320 arms are a free 4-seed control at exactly this cap.

smoke.why: four rollouts on the laptop, enough for the override line, one eval and a read of any ramp at a known fraction of the cap. Policy name is always smoke so the output is disposable.

control.results: results branch, results/b7-stageb/; runs/b7a[a-d]-fc320-seed*_evals.json for stage A

base.why: b7's fc (320,) reference: PPO's defaults, b2's reward, 4 epochs. Every value is stated explicitly rather than left to a default so a later default change cannot move the base under the sweep.

readouts: 1 stage-B >=98%/500 density, per seed and pooled, exact Mann-Whitney 4v4 against the control (0.029 = complete separation)
2 collapse share: post-competence stage-A evals below 50% perfect (and below 80%)
4 competence onset: first step at which trailing-30 >= 90%
6 hof-remeasure at 5,000 episodes over above:98.5 -- rows >=98.73 and >=99.0. Winners plus control only.
7 the curve: every readout plotted against the knob's value across the whole grid. A monotone trend across the grid is evidence a single 4v4 pair is not.

At 4 epochs there are only three stopping points. 0.1 was dropped as unable to fire; 0.04 and 0.05 are kept as the null check.

batches.notes: The other half of the rollout: how many games run in lockstep. Transitions per update = lanes x T, so 256 lanes at T=128 is the same batch as 128 lanes at T=256 -- but from twice as many independent episodes with half the per-episode depth. Read beside b14. Rollout size changes the stage-A interval exactly as T does.
